sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Fadahl is an obtainable Unit in the game. He is one of the Sacred Guardians of Meirith devoted into protecting the Holy Emperor Karna Masta. With a promising potential to be a priest, his dream was crumbled when an incurable disease struck him. It was until he was bestowed with a blessed armor that fully cured him off the disease, he later swore his devotion to the Holy Emperor and became a Guardian.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content: Fadahl and Quaid were being summoned and ordered to slay a demon named Ragruvord. During the mission, he receives a message from a disciple about the dissenters who intend to harm Karna Masta. He then choose to go back to aid Karna Masta with the twins of the group, Colt and Claire. Shortly after they arrives at the battlefield, they fought the Oracle Knight and his party. During the fight, Fadahl receives an injury from the necromancer of the Oracle Knight's party. Shortly afterwards, The Holy Emperor makes an appearance and finishes off Fadahl for good.
